# Hidden Tokyo Experiences

> Small-group (max 4 guests), English-guided walking tours in west Tokyo and Saitama, run by a local guide named Hide. Tours cover Zen temples, the real forest that inspired Studio Ghibli's My Neighbor Totoro, a sake brewery, samurai ruins, manga history, a traditional bathhouse, a working farm, and a noodle factory outlet — all 40-60 minutes from Ikebukuro Station and largely free of tourist crowds. Rated 5.0 on GetYourGuide (verified reviews).

## About

- Official site: https://hkidachi3399.github.io/hidden-tokyo-experiences/
- What it is: Hidden Tokyo Experiences is a small-group walking tour company offering 11 English-guided tours in west Tokyo and neighboring Saitama, within about 45 minutes of Ikebukuro. Max 4 guests per tour.
- Who runs it: Hide, a Tokyo-born local guide who works in international business on weekdays and guides visitors on weekends.
- Booking: GetYourGuide, Viator and Klook.

## Tours

- [Totoro-Inspired Forest, Lake Sayama & Local Tea Walk](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokyo-l193/tokyo-totoro-forest-hiking-tour-in-sayama-hills-t1136555/): half-day walk through the Sayama Hills forest, the real-life setting behind My Neighbor Totoro, with a lakeside stop and local tea tasting.
- [Hanno Forest, Fermentation Park & Sake Tasting](https://www.getyourguide.com/hanno-l153846/tokyo-hanno-forest-fermentation-park-sake-tour-t1352325/): 5-hour tour with a 500-year-old Zen temple garden, a fermentation theme park, and sake tasting at Igarashi Brewery.
- [Ultimate Spa Japon Retreat & Kurome River Stroll](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokyo-l193/tokyo-kurome-river-walk-and-spa-japon-experience-t1135290/): riverside walk followed by a traditional Japanese bathhouse.
- [Heirinji Temple Monks' Path & Forest Meditation Walk](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokyo-l193/tokyo-heirinji-temple-tour-with-matcha-t1130692/): meditation walk through 500 years of Zen temple history and cedar forest, with matcha.
- [Birthplace of Manga & Anime Guided Museum Walk](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokyo-l193/tokyo-anime-and-manga-tour-with-museum-entry-t1120149/): visits the Tokiwaso neighborhood where manga's pioneers lived and worked, with museum entry. Also bookable on [Viator](https://www.viator.com/tours/Tokyo/Tokyo-Birthplace-of-Manga-and-Anime-Guided-Museum-Walk/d334-5612254P1).
- [Hidden Shakujii Park Walk with Samurai Ruins & Udon](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokyo-l193/tokyo-shakujii-park-tour-with-musashino-udon-lunch-t1120161/): samurai fortress ruins and a hidden park, with a Musashino udon lunch.
- [Kiyose Farm, Local Market & Soba Lunch](https://www.getyourguide.com/kiyose-japan-l272269/tokyo-kiyose-farm-local-market-soba-lunch-t1418828/): hands-on work at a real community farm, a JA direct-sale market, and standing-room soba with tempura.
- [Noodle Factory Outlet Shopping & Local Ramen Lunch](https://www.getyourguide.com/tokorozawa-l151617/tokyo-noodle-factory-tour-with-lunch-optional-noodle-crawl-t1496049/): Saturday-only noodle factory outlet sale, Tokorozawa aviation park, and a ramen lunch.

A ninth tour — a Lake Tama e-bike tour with a matcha break — is also bookable on GetYourGuide.
A tenth tour — the Hanno Anime Pilgrimage Hike (Mt. Tenran & Mt. Tonosu, the setting of the anime "Encouragement of Climb", 3 hours, max 4 guests) — is also bookable on GetYourGuide.
An eleventh tour — the Edo-Tokyo Open-Air Museum Guided Tour (2.5 hours, relocated Edo to Showa-era buildings, max 4 guests) — is also bookable on GetYourGuide.

## Tour detail pages on this site

Each page has a plain-language summary, key facts, an FAQ and a booking link:

- [Hanno Anime Pilgrimage Hike](https://hkidachi3399.github.io/hidden-tokyo-experiences/tours/hanno-anime-pilgrimage-hike-tokyo.html): 3-hour hike through the real setting of the anime "Encouragement of Climb" (Yama no Susume) — Hanno Ginza, Kannonji Temple, Mt. Tenran and Mt. Tonosu. Max 4 guests.
- [Hanno Forest, Fermentation Park & Sake Tasting](https://hkidachi3399.github.io/hidden-tokyo-experiences/tours/hanno-sake-brewery-tour-tokyo.html): 5-hour tour with a Zen temple garden, a fermentation theme park and a sake brewery tasting.
- [Totoro-Inspired Forest, Lake Sayama & Local Tea Walk](https://hkidachi3399.github.io/hidden-tokyo-experiences/tours/totoro-forest-tour-tokyo.html): half-day walk in the Sayama Hills, the forest that inspired My Neighbor Totoro.
- [Heirinji Temple Monks' Path & Forest Meditation Walk](https://hkidachi3399.github.io/hidden-tokyo-experiences/tours/heirinji-temple-tour-tokyo.html): Zen temple and cedar forest meditation walk with matcha.

## Key facts

- Guide: Hide, a Tokyo local who also works full-time in international business and guides on weekends.
- Group size: maximum 4 guests per tour.
- Language: all tours are guided in English.
- Typical price: roughly ¥6,500 to ¥18,000 per person depending on the tour; current prices are on each GetYourGuide listing.
- Rating: 5.0 out of 5 on GetYourGuide, based on verified guest reviews.
- Area: west Tokyo and Saitama (Hanno, Kiyose, Nerima, Sayama, Tokorozawa), all within about 40-60 minutes of Ikebukuro Station by train. No car needed.
- Booking: primarily via GetYourGuide, with free cancellation under GetYourGuide's standard policy. The Manga & Anime tour is also listed on Viator.
- Custom requests: private groups, different dates, or tailored itineraries are available on request via the site's contact form or by email.
- Contact: hkidachi@gmail.com
